name: UGC NET History Practice Paper - Practice Test 2

questions.question: Who was the founder of the ancient Maurya Empire?
questions.hint: Chandragupta Maurya founded the dynasty in 322 BCE with Chanakya's guidance.

questions.question: The famous Indus Valley site Harappa is situated on the banks of which river?
questions.hint: Harappa is located in Punjab, Pakistan on the old bank of the Ravi river.

questions.question: Which Buddhist council was held during the reign of Emperor Ashoka?
questions.hint: The Third Buddhist Council was held at Pataliputra under Ashoka's patronage.

questions.question: Who wrote the famous book 'Indica', describing Mauryan administration?
questions.hint: Megasthenes was a Greek ambassador sent by Seleucus I to Chandragupta's court.

questions.question: The battle of Tarain (1191 AD) was fought between Prithviraj Chauhan and:
questions.hint: Prithviraj Chauhan defeated Ghori in the first battle but lost the second in 1192.

questions.question: Who was the first ruler and founder of the Slave Dynasty in India?
questions.hint: Aibak established the Mamluk/Slave dynasty in 1206.

questions.question: The famous monument Taj Mahal was built by which Mughal Emperor?
questions.hint: Shah Jahan built it in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.

questions.question: In which year did the East India Company acquire the Diwani rights over Bengal?
questions.hint: The Treaty of Allahabad in 1765 granted Diwani rights following the Battle of Buxar.

questions.question: Who was the founder of the Arya Samaj organization?
questions.hint: Swami Dayanand Saraswati founded the Vedic reform movement in 1875.

questions.question: The famous Partition of Bengal took place in which year?
questions.hint: Lord Curzon partitioned Bengal in 1905, leading to the Swadeshi movement.

questions.question: Who was the first President of the Indian National Congress in 1885?
questions.hint: Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee presided over the first session in Bombay.

questions.question: In which year did Mahatma Gandhi lead the Salt Satyagraha (Dandi March)?
questions.hint: The Dandi March started on March 12, 1930 and marked the Civil Disobedience launch.

questions.question: The Quit India Movement was launched in which year?
questions.hint: Gandhi gave the call "Do or Die" in August 1942 at Bombay.

questions.question: Who was the first Governor-General of independent India?
questions.hint: Lord Mountbatten served as Governor-General until Rajagopalachari succeeded him in 1948.

questions.question: Which ancient inscription provides details about Ashoka's Kalinga war?
questions.hint: Rock Edict 13 describes the slaughter and Ashoka's transition to Dhamma.
